title: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that the Second Circuit Court of Appeals denied the company's petition for rehearing on April 16, 2026, upholding a prior judgment awarding $36.9 million to Alta Partners and $51.0 million to CRCM Institutional Master Fund in warrant litigation. The company maintains a litigation reserve for the full judgment amount and plans to draw on its revolving credit facility to satisfy the obligation.
key_points: Second Circuit denied Getty Images' petition for rehearing on April 16, 2026, affirming prior judgment in favor of warrant holders Alta Partners and CRCM
Original district court judgment (October 27, 2023): $36.9 million awarded to Alta for 2,066,371 public warrants; $51.0 million awarded to CRCM for 3,010,764 public warrants
Pre-judgment interest accrues at 9% per annum on both awards
Court of Appeals Second Circuit affirmed judgment in all respects on January 15, 2026, with one judge dissenting
Company recorded a loss in 2023 under ASC 450 and maintains litigation reserve covering full judgment and related interest
Getty Images, Inc. intends to draw on existing undrawn revolving credit facility to pay the judgment
why_it_matters: This is a corporate legal matter for Getty Images (ticker: GETY) concerning warrant litigation. The final denial of rehearing ends the company's legal options to contest the judgment. The company must now pay approximately $87.9 million plus interest. This is material for Getty Images shareholders and creditors as it will reduce liquidity via credit facility draw, but it has no relevance to broad market structure or macro economic catalysts.
